title: Tailwind CSS
description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapidly building custom designs.

data.text: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that provides low-level utility classes to build custom designs directly in your markup. Instead of writing custom CSS, you compose styles using pre-defined classes like flex, pt-4, and text-center.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p

terms.definition: A CSS approach where styles are composed using small, single-purpose classes directly in markup.
A tool for transforming CSS with JavaScript plugins; Tailwind uses it under the hood.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Tailwind provides utility classes for rapid UI development
Works with PostCSS and PurgeCSS for production
data.takeaway: Tailwind CSS eliminates the need for custom CSS by providing a composable utility API.
